title: Shared definitions of the work plan's schemas

t.description: A TODO item's number, such as T001. Numbers are never reused.

issue.description: A GitHub issue number in the plan's repository.

issueRef.description: An existing issue's number, or "new" to have plan.mjs create the issue and record it.

rowRef.description: A row of the /todo chart, by its group's id and its own id.

state.description: A chart row's state: done, in progress (now) or next.
